spans.s: To wash, cleanse, purify; सस्नुः पयः पपुरनेनिजुरम्बराणि Śi. 5. 28.
To wash or clean oneself, to be purified (Ā.).
To nourish. ━With {@निस्@} to wash, clean, purify; तोयनिर्णिक्तपाणयः

Own, oneʼs own, relating to one-self, of oneʼs own party or country;
 निजं वपुः पुनरनयन्निजां रुचिम् Śi. 17. 4;

Continual, perpetual. ━m. (pl.) Oneʼs own people.
.━{@Comp.@}: निजबोधः

+ -बोधः Self-knowledge, spiritual knowledge; भिक्षुर्न चाहं निजबोधरूपः
 Hastāmalaka Stotra.
